biotools.summary: CTFMeasure is a software tool for estimating contrast transfer function (CTF) parameters and absolute tilt angle offset in cryo-electron tomography tilt series. It utilizes tilt-series-based joint estimation and Thon ring rescaling to improve accuracy and provides utilities for FIB milling lamellas.
